assertions.name: character_ratios_exact
assertions.source: Per-partition ratios q², 1/(h²+1), q⁻² verified to machine precision

description: Derives meson mass structure from string-breaking (σ²=hσ+1) and exact Hecke characters. Key: the per-partition character ratios χ(K)/χ(π) are q^{±2} for 1-dim reps and 1/(h²+1) for the standard rep — all derivable from representation theory. The trace ratio tr_K/tr_π is fully determined by these ratios.
